messages.subject: Sentinel - HSE meeting 4 March, 11:00
messages.plaintextBody:
Good morning,

Confirming the meeting with HM Inspector Whitlow this Wednesday 4 March at 11:00, at our offices (22 Bishopsgate). Attending for the Company: Richard Pennington, Naomi Patel; for us: Sarah Whitfield and Tom Gallagher. Pre-meeting at 10:15. Please let me know of any dietary requirements for lunch.

Kind regards,
Donna Bridges
Practice Assistant, Whitfield Carter LLP
